description: Which episodes of a podcast have a publisher-provided transcript, and where: reads the show's own RSS feed live and lists every episode's Podcasting 2.0 <podcast:transcript> links with their format (SRT, WebVTT, JSON, text, HTML), language and URL. Episodes without one are kept in the list and labelled transcript_status "no_publisher_transcript", and a show that publishes none says so plainly with its episode list intact. Pass a show_id or podcast:guid from find_podcast_contacts, or the RSS feed URL directly. Use search_podcast_transcript to pull timestamped passages from one.

episode.description: Narrow to one episode: its guid, page or audio URL, episode number ("273" or "#273"), or words from its title. Omit for the latest episodes.

id.description: The show: a show_id from find_podcast_contacts, the RSS feed URL, or its podcast:guid.

name: list_podcast_transcripts
